header: You have the thought but not the words? No problem.
text: Sound familiar? You know what you want to say, but not how. Here it's not a dead end: say it however you can — in the language you're learning or in your native one, a single word or whole sentences, and the assistant will show you how to say it right.
note: You can type your answer <keyboard></keyboard> or dictate it <wave></wave>

dontKnow.title: Don’t know how to say it
dontKnow.thought: A cappuccino to go, and quick: I’m running late.
dontKnow.doubtLabel: Doubting and not knowing is fine
dontKnow.doubt: Capuchino… but how do you say “to go”? And “quick”?
dontKnow.call: Just say it however you can!
dontKnow.answer: Quiero capuchino, to go, and quick

hint.title: Get a hint
hint.phrase: ¿Me pones un capuchino para llevar, por favor? Voy con un poco de prisa.

replacements.target: Voy con un poco de prisa

hint.text: See how it really sounds and what changed.

sayRight.title: Say it right
sayRight.userLine: ¿Me pones un capuchino para llevar, por favor? Voy con un poco de prisa.
sayRight.npcLine: ¡Claro! Ahora mismo te lo preparo. Qué tarde tan lluviosa, ¿verdad?
sayRight.text: You were understood, and the story moved on.
